prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: polished indoor wooden floorboards, warm honey brown, boards running horizontally (about 8 art pixels wide), staggered joints, subtle grain. The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Create a square, seamless tileable top-down JRPG map ground texture consisting ONLY of polished indoor wooden floorboards. Premium modern hi-bit hand-placed 2D pixel art, crisp uniformly sized square pixels, no antialiasing. Warm honey brown planks running perfectly horizontally across the canvas, each board roughly 8 art pixels tall, staggered vertical joints, restrained and evenly distributed subtle grain in clearly shaped clusters of 3–10 pixels. Rich earthy hues with 4–6 shades per material; shadow lines lean slightly saturated reddish purple, sparse highlights lean warm golden yellow. Lived-in polished wood, with narrow neat seams. Orthographic top-down view, no perspective. Flat clean base colors, neutral soft even lighting; no shadows cast by objects, no light pools, no glow, no vignette. CRITICAL seamlessly tileable at BOTH horizontal and vertical boundaries: left edge must flow precisely into right edge and top edge into bottom edge; regular board spacing and grain continuity across boundaries. Full bleed surface only, no border, frame, objects, text, or focal point. No blur, photo texture, random noise, soft brushes, or checkerboard dithering.
